blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Agent skills adapt frozen models through editable external instructions. Revising several rules at once makes changes difficult to inspect, while judging each local edit only by its immediate score can discard useful intermediate states. We introduce AtomSearch, which keeps revision actions local while using subsequent skill states to guide search. Contrastive atomic editing links each primitive rule edit to failed and successful executions, a behavioral hypothesis, and an intended scope. Skill-State Tree Search (STS) evaluates short edit compositions and selectively retains them as executable states that can be revisited and extended. Outcome memory supplies later proposals with observed repair and regression statistics. We evaluate AtomSearch across four tasks and five target models. With deepseek-v4-flash, it exceeds SkillOpt on three of four tasks, including a 9.68-percentage-point gain on LiveMathematicianBench, and SkillOpt's final skills contain 2.3-19.7 times as many characters. In 67% of completed searches, the best validation state passes through an ancestor that was not highest-scoring at its depth. These results show how local rule edits can support the exploration of useful revision paths and yield compact skills, with additional offline evaluations used to explore alternative states.
blocks.zh: 代理技能通过可编辑的外部指令来适应冷冻模型. 立即修改若干规则使得修改难以检查,而仅根据其即时得分判断每个本地编辑就可以丢弃有用的中间状态. 我们引入了AtomSearch,它使修改动作保持局部,同时使用后续的技能状态来指导搜索. 矛盾的原子编辑将每一个原始规则编辑链接到失败和成功的处决,一个行为假设,以及一个预定的范围. Skill-State Tree Search(STS)评价短版编辑组成,并有选择地将其保留为可执行状态,可以重新审视和扩展. 结果记忆为后来的建议提供了可观察到的修复和回归统计。 我们评价AtomSearch的四项任务和五个目标模型。 随着深层Seek-v4-flash,它在四个任务中的三个任务超过了SkillOpt,其中包括在LiveMathematician Bench上9.68的百分点增益,SkillOpt的最终技能包含2.3-19.7倍的人物. 在67%完成的搜索中,最好的验证状态通过一个在深度没有达到最高分的祖先. 这些结果显示,地方规则编辑如何能支持探索有用的修订路径,并产生紧凑的技能,同时使用额外的离线评价来探索替代状态.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Agent skills package task-specific instructions, procedures, scripts, and supporting resources into reusable artifacts that an agent can load at execution time ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . Because the skill sits outside the model parameters, it can be revised without retraining the underlying model. Reusable artifacts also include executable code skills, as in Voyager ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . We study how execution feedback can improve a fixed agent by revising its skill instructions.
blocks.zh: 代理技能包 针对任务的特定指令,程序,脚本,以及辅助资源,作为代理在执行时可以加载的可再使用文物(张等,2025a. 由于技能坐落在模型参数之外,因此无需再培训基础模型即可被修改. 可重复使用的文物还包括可执行代码技能,如Voyager(Wang等,2023年). 我们研究执行反馈如何通过修订其技能指示来改进固定代理.

blocks.en: The hard part is deciding what a revision should be and how its value should be judged. A candidate update may change several behavioral rules at once. If the score rises, the gain is assigned to the whole update rather than to a specific change; if it falls, the source of the regression is equally unclear. Repeating this process can also leave behind rules whose individual value was never established, so the skill grows even when some additions are redundant.
blocks.zh: 困难的部分是决定修订的内容以及如何判断其价值。 候选人更新可能会同时改变几个行为规则. 如果分数上升,则增益被分配到整个更新而不是特定的变化;如果下降,回归的来源同样不明确. 重复这个过程也可以留下那些从未建立过个人价值的规则,所以即使一些添加是多余的,技能也会增长.

blocks.en: Recent work already addresses parts of this problem. SkillOpt restricts revisions to bounded add, delete, or replace operations and validates candidates on held-out data ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . Skill- α \alpha decomposes skill generation into individually evaluable sequential edits ( Shen et al., 2026 ) , and SkillRevise uses execution traces to diagnose defects before applying targeted repairs ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Tree-based methods address a different limitation: bilevel skill optimization uses MCTS to search skill structure ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , while SkillHEX maintains persistent revision branches under sparse test-time feedback ( Feng et al., 2026 ) . These methods make revisions more controlled or broaden the search, but the revision unit and the horizon used to value that revision are still largely separate design choices.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作已经解决这个问题的部分内容。 SkillOpt限制修改以添加、删除或替换操作,并验证被搁置数据上的候选人(Yang等人,2026年)。 Skill-α-α将技能生成分解为单个可评价的相继编辑(Shen等,2026年),SkillRevise在应用定向修复前使用执行痕迹来诊断缺陷(Liu等,2026年). 基于树的方法解决了不同的限制:双层技能优化使用MCTS搜索技能结构(Huang等,2026年),而SkillHEX则在稀疏的测试时间反馈下维持了持久的修订分支(Feng等,2026年). 这些方法使得修改更能控制或拓宽搜索范围,但用于评价修改内容的修改单元和地平线仍然在很大程度上是独立的设计选择.

blocks.en: Fine-grained edits can still interact. One edit may establish a condition under which a later edit becomes useful despite little immediate gain. It may also enable a correction that would not have been proposed from the original state. An optimizer that keeps only locally strong states can therefore discard useful paths. Figure 5 shows one such path, where a weaker intermediate state leads to the best state in the tree.
blocks.zh: 精细的编辑仍然可以交互. 一次编辑可能会规定一个条件,在这种条件下,以后的编辑尽管没有立即获得什么好处,但变得有用。 这还可能促成从原始状态中不会提出的更正。 因此,只有保持当地强态的优化器才能丢弃有用的路径。 图5显示了一条这样的路径,其中较弱的中间状态导致树上最好的状态.

blocks.en: AtomSearch decouples the granularity of revision from the horizon over which revision paths are evaluated: each proposal specifies one primitive rule edit, while later outcomes guide exploration of its path. Contrastive atomic editing links the edit to failed and successful executions, a behavioral hypothesis, scope, expected effect, and operation rationale. The change and its evidence are traceable; execution measures the resulting skill’s performance.
blocks.zh: AtomSearch从评价修正路径的地平线上解析了修正的颗粒性:每个提案都指定了一条原始规则编辑,而后期结果指导了对其路径的探索. 相矛盾的原子编辑将编辑链接到失败和成功的执行,一种行为假设,范围,预期效果,以及操作原理. 变化及其证据是可追踪的;执行量度由此产生的技能表现。

blocks.en: Skill-State Tree Search (STS) then evaluates that local action in a broader search context. Each node is a complete executable skill. Alternative revision paths remain searchable, and short deterministic rollouts test whether a primitive edit becomes useful after additional edits. When a rollout beats its primitive child, its composition becomes a persistent state that can be revisited. The edit stays local, but its value is allowed to emerge over later skill states.
blocks.zh: 然后,Skill-State树搜索(STS)在更广泛的搜索背景下评价了本地行动. 每个节点都是完整的可执行技能. 可选择的修订路径仍然可以搜索,简短的确定性推出测试在追加编辑后原始编辑是否变得有用. 当一次推出击败了它的原始孩子时,其组成就成为了可以再审的持久状态. 编辑会保持本地状态, 但允许它的价值出现在以后的技能状态上。

blocks.en: Execution also reveals repair and regression outcomes that a scalar score hides. A revision can repair failed cases, break previously correct ones, or repeat a direction that has already been tried. We keep this information in a bounded outcome memory and expose selected records to later proposal rounds. The tree controls where search effort goes; the memory supplies the proposer with what earlier revisions actually did.
blocks.zh: 执行还揭示出一个分数隐藏的修复和回归结果. 修改可以修复失败的个案,打破以前正确的个案,或者重复已经尝试过的方向. 我们把这一信息保存在有限度的结果记忆中,并将选定的记录暴露在以后的几轮提案中。 树控制搜索努力进行的地方;内存为提议者提供了之前的修改实际做的.

blocks.en: Repeated skill revision of this kind is closely related to recursive self-improvement (RSI), in which an agent keeps improving the artifacts that govern its own behavior ( Zelikman et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . The longer such a loop runs, the more it matters that each edit can be traced to its evidence and that earlier repairs and regressions are remembered; contrastive atomic editing and outcome memory provide both. The skill growth noted earlier matters as well, since every accepted change is another chance for the skill to lengthen.
blocks.zh: 这种技术的反复修订与递归自修(RSI)密切相关,其中一剂不断改进管理自己行为的文物(Zelikman等,2023;张等,2025b;张等,2026;吴等,2026.). 这种循环运行的时间越长,每一次编辑就越能被追溯到其证据,以及更早的修复和回归被记住;对比性的原子编辑和结果记忆提供了两者. 技能增长也注意到前面的问题,因为每一个公认的变化都是技能延长的又一次机会。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of AtomSearch. Contrastive atomic editing (top) contrasts failed and passed executions into edit specifications and ranked primitive edits. Skill-State Tree Search (left and bottom) applies the top-ranked edit at the node selected by UCT, also scores a short lookahead with up to two further edits, keeps the lookahead only if it beats the primitive child, and backs up the kept state’s reward. Outcome memory (right) records repairs and regressions per edit for later proposals; its counts are schematic.
blocks.zh: 图1:原子搜索概览。 相矛盾的原子编辑(top)对比失败并被执行通过为编辑规格并排名原始编辑. Skill-State Tree search(左下方)在UCT选择的节点应用了排名最高的编辑方式,也给一个短的取景头加上最多两个再编辑的取景头,只有在击败了原始孩子时才保留取景头,并备份保留状态的奖励. 结果内存(右)记录修复和每编辑一次回归,以备日后的提案;其计数为图表.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • We define a contrastive atomic revision interface that binds execution evidence, a behavioral hypothesis, and scope to one primitive rule edit. Alternative corrections remain separate candidates that search can test and combine. • We develop Skill-State Tree Search over complete executable skills. Lookahead compositions that improve on their primitive child are kept as tree nodes, allowing their outcomes to guide further exploration of earlier revision paths. • We incorporate an outcome memory that supplies later proposals with attempted revision directions and repair/regression statistics. Results from a shared evaluation remain attached to the edit composition that produced them. • Across four tasks and five targets, we measure performance, retained edit paths, skill size, and offline cost. With deepseek-v4-flash, AtomSearch exceeds SkillOpt on three tasks and produces shorter skills on all four; the recorded search trees also expose useful paths through locally weaker states.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献是: 我们定义了一个对比性的原子修正界面,将执行证据,行为假说,范围绑定在一个原始规则编辑上. • 可供选择的更正仍然是可以测试和合并的单独候选人。 我们开发Skill-State Tree搜索 超越了完整的可执行技能. 将改善原始孩子的外观结构保留为树节点,使其结果能够指导对更早的修订路径的进一步探索。 我们纳入了一种成果记忆,为后来的建议提供了修改方向和修复/倒退统计数据。 共同评价的结果仍然附在产生这些结果的编辑组成上。 • 在四项任务和五项目标中,我们衡量业绩、保留编辑路径、技能大小和离线费用。 深视- v4- 闪光, 原子搜索超过 TechleOpt承担了三项任务,并在所有四项任务上产生更短的技能;所记录的搜索树也暴露出通过当地较弱的州而有用的路径.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Prompt optimizers search instructions ( Zhou et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) , revise them using textual feedback ( Pryzant et al., 2023 ; Yuksekgonul et al., 2024 ) , or evolve candidate populations ( Guo et al., 2024 ; Fernando et al., 2024 ) . DSPy optimizes modular LM programs, and MIPRO jointly optimizes their instructions and demonstrations using end-to-end evaluation ( Khattab et al., 2024 ; Opsahl-Ong et al., 2024 ) . Other methods narrow the revision unit. ConstitutionalExperts edits individual principles ( Petridis et al., 2024 ) ; AvaTaR contrasts successful and unsuccessful training examples to improve agent prompts ( Wu et al., 2024 ) ; Contrastive Reflection uses failures and nearby successful cases for targeted repairs ( Koh et al., 2026 ) . SkillOpt applies bounded edits under validation, Skill- α \alpha evaluates sequential edits, and SkillRevise diagnoses defects from execution traces ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . AtomSearch uses this feedback to specify one primitive rule edit as a search action, keeping its hypothesis and scope attached to the action.
blocks.zh: 快速优化器搜索指令 (周等,2023;杨等,2024),用文字反馈修改(普赖赞等,2023;于克塞克贡努尔等,2024),或进化候选人口. (郭等,2024;费尔南多等,2024.). DSPy优化了模块化LM程序,MIPRO通过端到端评价共同优化其指令和演示(Khattab等,2024;Opsahl-Ong等,2024.). 其他方法缩小了修订单元。 宪法专家编辑了个别原则(Petridis等,2024年;AvaTAR对比成功和不成功的培训实例来改进代理提示(Wu等,2024年;Contrastic Reflection使用失败和相邻的成功案例进行有针对性的修复(Koh等,2026年). SkillOpt在验证中应用了受约束的编辑,Skill-α\alpha评价了相继的编辑,SkillRevise从执行痕迹中诊断出缺陷(杨等,2026;沈等,2026;刘等,2026). AtomSearch利用这种反馈指定了一条原始规则编辑作为搜索动作,保持其假设和范围附在动作上.

blocks.en: Tree of Thoughts explores intermediate reasoning paths, while LATS combines tree search with actions, environment feedback, and reflection ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) . These methods search task-solving trajectories. Search can also optimize artifacts reused across tasks: prompts, workflows, and heuristics ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) . ADAS generates agent programs using an archive of previous designs ( Hu et al., 2025 ) . GEPA uses trajectory reflection to evolve prompts and maintains a Pareto set of complementary candidates ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) . For skills, bilevel optimization searches structure and refines content, while SkillHEX maintains revision branches under sparse feedback ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026 ) . AtomSearch searches complete executable skills, with primitive edits as local actions; edit compositions that improve on their primitive child are kept as tree nodes.
blocks.zh: "思想之树"探索了中间推理路径,而"LATS"则结合了树搜索与动作,环境反馈,和反思(姚等,2023;周等,2024. 这些方法搜索任务解决轨迹. 搜索还可以优化跨任务再利用的文物:提示,工作流程,和heuristics(王等等,2024;张等,2025c;郑等,2025. ADAS使用之前的设计存档生成代理程序(Hu等,2025年) . GEPA利用轨迹反射来演化出提示并维持一套Pareto补充候选人(Agrawal等人,2026年)。 对于技能,双层优化搜索结构并完善内容,而SkillHEX则在稀少的反馈下维持修订分支(Huang等,2026;Feng等,2026). AtomSearch搜索完成可执行技能,原始编辑作为局部动作;改进原始子的编辑成分被保存为树节点.

blocks.en: Self-Refine and CRITIC use self-feedback and tool-based critique to revise outputs ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Gou et al., 2024 ) . Across attempts or tasks, agents reuse verbal reflections and extracted experience ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) , induced workflows ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and evolving strategy notes ( Suzgun et al., 2025 ) . ACE maintains a structured playbook through reflection and incremental updates ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) ; SkillOpt also retains rejected-edit feedback and optimization guidance ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . Our memory stores revision directions and observed repair/regression statistics for later proposals, retaining joint provenance when edits share an evaluation. The amount of retained content is a separate design choice: ACE preserves detailed knowledge, whereas SkillReducer explicitly targets token efficiency ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . AtomSearch has no length objective; its final skill sizes are measured outcomes.
blocks.zh: 自我参考书和CRITIC使用自我反馈和基于工具的批评来修改产出(Madaan等,2023;Gou等,2024)。 在各种尝试或任务中,物剂重复使用口头反射和提取出的经验(Shinn等,2023;Zhao等,2024;诱导工作流程(Wang等,2025;和演变中的战略说明(Suzgun等,2025;)). ACE通过反射和递增更新维持有条理的游戏本(Zhang等,2026年;Skill). Opt还保留了拒绝编辑的反馈和优化指导(Yang等,2026.). 我们的记忆存储了修改方向和观察到的修复/后退统计数据,用于以后的提案,在编辑共享评价时保留了共同来源. 所保留内容的量是一个单独的设计选择:ACE保存了详细的知识,而SkillReductioner则明确针对象征效率(张等,2026;高等,2026.). AtomSearch没有长度目标;其最终技能大小是被测量的结果.

blocks.en: 3.1 Contrastive Atomic Editing
blocks.zh: 3.1 对比原子编辑

blocks.en: We represent a skill as a sequence of addressable rule atoms. At each proposal round, the optimizer contrasts failed and successful executions and returns edit specifications together with their edits. A specification has five fields. support_ids cites failed executions from the current minibatch that fail for the same underlying reason, and counterexample_ids cites at least one successful execution whose behavior the edit must preserve. hypothesis states the behavioral distinction inferred from this contrast, scope states when it applies and when it does not, and expected_effect names the failures to be repaired and the successful behavior to be kept. The optimizer also explains the chosen operation and edit count. Each edit cites one specification through criterion_id and performs one primitive operation: add , rewrite , or delete ; one specification justifies at most one edit.

At termination, STS uses a recursive adaptation of the robust-child recommendation rule ( Browne et al., 2012 ) .
Starting from the root, it repeatedly selects the most visited child, stopping at a leaf or when the selected child has at most one visit.

blocks.en: 3.3 Outcome Memory
blocks.zh: 3.3 结果记忆

blocks.en: We supplement tree statistics with a bounded outcome memory of attempted revision directions and their repair/regression outcomes. Each record contains the attempted direction, an outcome tag, and the available aggregate repair and regression counts. When several edits share one evaluation, the record marks that result as belonging to the composition rather than assigning it to every edit separately. Failed attempts remain in the history as well.
blocks.zh: 我们用关于修订方向及其修复/退后结果的有限度结果记忆来补充树木统计。 每一份记录都包含尝试的方向、结果标记以及可用的总修和回归计数。 当多个编辑共享一个评价时,记录会标出属于组成,而不是将其单独分配给每个编辑. 失败的尝试也留在历史中。

blocks.en: Before another proposal round, the optimizer receives a bounded subset of these records: aggregate track records for explored directions together with selected past attempts. The memory is used only when proposing edits. It does not change UCT, progressive widening, or the search reward. We keep that boundary explicit because the two signals serve different purposes. Repair and regression counts summarize what a revision changed on individual examples, while tree values compare complete skill states on the navigation objective. Folding the former into UCT would mix those scales and make search allocation harder to interpret. The memory therefore changes what the proposer sees; execution still determines the value used by the tree.
blocks.zh: 在另一轮提议之前,优化器收到这些记录的一个有界限的子集:用于探索方向的集合轨道记录以及选定的过去尝试. 内存仅在提议编辑时使用. 它不会改变UCT, 渐进扩大, 或搜索奖励。 我们保持明确的边界,因为这两个信号服务于不同的目的。 修补和回归计数总结了单个实例的修订变化,而树值则比较了导航目标的完整技能状态. 将前者折叠入UCT将混合这些尺度,使搜索分配更难解释。 因此,内存会改变提议者所看到的;执行仍然决定了树所使用的值.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate AtomSearch on Network Detection and Response (NDR), an in-house security task, and three public benchmarks: SpreadsheetBench ( Ma et al., 2024 ) , SearchQA ( Dunn et al., 2017 ) , and LiveMathematicianBench ( He et al., 2026 ) . The public tasks cover spreadsheet manipulation, search-grounded question answering, and mathematical reasoning. The frozen target models are deepseek-v4-flash, GPT-5.2, GPT-5.5, Qwen3.5-4B, and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. We optimize only the external skill.
blocks.zh: 我们评价关于网络探测和反应的AtomSearch(NDR),这是一项内部安全任务,以及三项公共基准: 电子表格 Bench (Ma等, 2024年),"搜索QA" (Dunn等, 2017年),"活数学家 Bench" (He等, 2026年). 公共任务包括电子表格操作、搜索后的问题回答和数学推理。 被冻结的目标型号有:深 Seek-v4-flash,GPT-5.2,GPT-5.5,Quen3.5-4B和Quen3.6-35B-A3B. 我们只能优化外部技能。

blocks.en: NDR is an in-house dataset of HTTP traffic records constructed for network detection and response. All records are de-identified before use, and the dataset contains no personally identifiable information. For each record, the agent predicts an attack-status label ( IsAttack ), its type ( AttackType ), and its outcome ( AttackResult ). A prediction is correct only when the required fields jointly match the reference, including required empty outputs; attack types are compared as normalized sets. This setting tests whether explicit rules help distinguish evidence of an attack attempt from evidence that it succeeded. We evaluate the resulting skills offline on held-out records. NDR complements the public benchmarks with a domain-specific security task in which correct predictions require consistent reasoning across several labeled fields.
blocks.zh: NDR是HTTP流量记录为网络检测和响应而构建的内部数据集. 所有记录在使用前都是去识别的,数据集中没有个人可识别的信息. 对于每一记录,代理预测攻击状态标签(IsAttack ),其类型(Attack Type ),及其结果(AttackResult . 只有当需要的字段共同匹配引用,包括需要的空输出时,预测才是正确的;将攻击类型与常态集进行比较. 这种设定检验明确规则是否有助于区分攻击企图的证据与成功的证据。 我们评价由此产生的技能在被搁置的记录上脱线。 NDR以一个针对特定域的安全任务来补充公共基准,其中正确的预测需要在若干被标注字段上一致的推理.

blocks.en: Our primary baseline is SkillOpt ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . The paired trajectory comparisons use the same underlying data splits and task-skill initialization. Execution feedback is used to construct candidate revisions, while a held-out validation panel (the navigation set 𝒟 nav \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{nav}} ) provides the signal used during optimization and skill selection. The test split is reserved for final reporting and is not used to generate revisions or guide tree search. For validation-trajectory analyses, both methods are evaluated on the same examples.
blocks.zh: 我们的首要基线是技能 Opt (Yang等, 2026) (中文(简体) ). 配对的轨迹比较使用相同的基础数据分解和任务技能初始化. 执行反馈用于构建候选修改,而一个被搁置的验证面板(导航集 Dnav{ mathcal{ D}_{\ mathrm{nav}}})则提供优化和技能选择时使用的信号. 测试分拆被保留用于最终报告,不用于生成修改或引导树搜索. 为了进行验证-导出分析,这两种方法都以相同的例子加以评价。

blocks.en: Final test scores hide the revision path. Figure 3 instead plots validation accuracy against cumulative edits on the reported trajectory. AtomSearch follows the root-to-validation-argmax path and omits edits explored on other branches; SkillOpt follows its incumbent chain. These curves describe path length, not total search computation.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Revision trajectories on shared validation panels. AtomSearch counts edits only along the displayed root-to-validation-argmax path, while SkillOpt follows its incumbent skill chain. All points are single recorded evaluations. Both paths include a score decrease before reaching their maxima. Edit counts exclude candidates explored off the displayed path.

On SpreadsheetBench, AtomSearch reaches 73.75 after four edits, while SkillOpt reaches 72.50 after 20 and stays there through edit 38. The tree uses additional evaluations to find those retained paths.

blocks.en: In 20 of 30 completed searches (67%), the best validation state has at least one ancestor that is not the highest-scoring state observed at the same depth. Such an ancestor need not be worse than its own parent, but a depth-wise immediate-score ranking would still prefer another branch.
blocks.zh: 在30个完成的搜索中,有20个(67%),最好的验证状态至少有一个祖先不是在同一深度观察到的最高得分状态. 这样的祖先不需要比自己的亲生父母更差,但深度直接得分的排名仍然倾向于另一个分支.

blocks.en: 4.5 Compact Final Skills
blocks.zh: 4.5 契约最终技能

blocks.en: Figure 5 compares the final artifacts with SkillOpt and with the initial skill. For deepseek-v4-flash, SkillOpt’s final skills are 2.3–19.7 times as long across the four benchmarks. On NDR, the ratio is 2.3 × \times to 3.3 × \times across the three target models shown. AtomSearch does not optimize length, so the compact artifacts are an empirical outcome of the retained revision paths. In the ablation, the size drop appears as soon as contrastive atomic editing is added (16,536 to 2,352 characters; Table 3 ), so the reported task gains do not require continued rule accumulation.
blocks.zh: 图5 将最终文物与斯克洛特(SkillOpt)和初始技能进行比较. Skillopt的最终技能是四大基准的2.3-19.7倍。 在NDR上,所显示的三种目标模型的比为2.3×相和3.3×相和. AtomSearch没有优化长度,因此紧凑的文物是所保留修正路径的经验性结果. 在通缩中,大小下降一旦加入对比原子编辑(16,536到2,352个字符;表3)就立即出现,因此所报的任务增益不需要继续规则积累.

blocks.en: 4.6 Component Analysis and Optimization Cost
blocks.zh: 4.6 构成部分分析和优化费用

Contrastive atomic editing accounts for most of the change: relative to Base, it raises the test score from 68.93 to 75.71 and shrinks the skill from 16,536 to 2,352 characters. Adding Skill-State Tree Search raises the score to 77.14, and adding outcome memory gives 78.21 for the full method. The later two steps are smaller (1.43 and 1.07 points, or 4 and 3 of 280 test items) and come from one task–target setting.

blocks.en: Short retained paths require additional offline evaluation. In the 17 documented runs, the optimizer is called 16–45 times; Appendix B.2 reports item-evaluation counts and cache usage.
blocks.zh: 短路需要额外的离线评价。 在17个记录运行中,优化器称为16-45次;附录B.2报告项目评价计数和缓存使用.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和限制

blocks.en: AtomSearch exchanges additional offline evaluation for exploration of alternative revision paths. This trade-off is most relevant when the resulting skill is reused across many executions. Adaptive rollout budgets and selective re-evaluation are natural next steps for reducing the search cost while preserving promising alternatives.
blocks.zh: AtomSearch 交换额外的离线评价来探索替代的修订路径. 在许多处决中重新使用由此产生的技能时,这种取舍最为相关。 适应性的推出预算和有选择的再评价,是降低搜索成本,同时保留有希望的替代办法的自然后继步骤。

blocks.en: The separation between revision granularity and valuation horizon is deliberate. A small edit is easier to inspect, but its usefulness need not be visible at the same step. STS spends extra evaluations to preserve that distinction: the action remains local while later executable states can determine whether its path deserves more search. The traces in Section 4.4 show that such paths occur in the current runs.
blocks.zh: 修订颗粒性和估价前景之间的分离是有意的。 一个小的编辑比较容易检查,但其有用性不需要在同一步骤上可见. STS花费额外的评价来保持这种区分:动作仍然是局部的而后可执行状态可以决定其路径是否值得更多的搜索. 第4.4节中的痕迹表明,这些路径出现在目前的运行中。

blocks.en: Finite validation panels and stochastic execution limit the precision of small score differences, and selecting among many candidates can overfit the validation criterion ( Cawley & Talbot, 2010 ) . The component ablation covers one task–target setting, where the increments from search and outcome memory are small; extending it across tasks and evaluation budgets would show how they vary. NDR is a single in-house task, and its results measure offline accuracy only.
blocks.zh: 有限度的验证板和有条理地执行限制了小分分差的精度,在很多候选人中选择可以超额匹配验证标准(Cawley & Talbot, 2010.). 这部分内容包括一项任务-目标设定,其中搜索和结果记忆的增量很小;将它扩大到任务和评价预算之间,将显示它们的差异。 NDR是单一的内部任务,其成果只衡量离线准确性.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: AtomSearch keeps skill revisions local while allowing later edit combinations to inform search. Contrastive atomic editing makes each action and its evidence explicit; Skill-State Tree Search preserves evaluated compositions as extensible states; outcome memory carries observed revision outcomes into later proposals. Across the evaluated settings, AtomSearch produces compact skills and improves several task–model pairs. Its search traces show that locally weaker states can lead to the best discovered skill, at the cost of additional offline evaluation. Attributable edits and compact skills also carry over to RSI, where an agent that keeps revising its own skills needs both.
blocks.zh: AtomSearch 保留了本地的技能修改,同时允许后期编辑组合为搜索提供信息. 矛盾的原子编辑使每个动作及其证据都明确; 技能状态树搜索将评价的构成保留为可扩展状态; 结果记忆将观察到的修订结果带入后期提案。 AtomSearch 在整个被评价的设置中,生成了紧凑的技巧并改进了数个任务-模型对. 其搜索痕迹显示,当地较弱的州能以额外的离线评价为代价,获得所发现的最佳技能. 可归属编辑和紧凑技能也延续到RSI,一个不断修订自身技能的代理人需要两者.

blocks.en: Table 2 reports six comparisons, comprising SpreadsheetBench with deepseek-v4-flash and NDR with five targets. This analysis includes comparisons with an executed SkillOpt baseline, excluded validation gains below five percentage points, and excluded LiveMathematicianBench, whose validation panel has 18 items. We treat these six comparisons as a descriptive subset rather than an estimate over the full task–model matrix.
blocks.zh: 表2报告了6项比较,包括电子表格 " Bench " 和 " DR " ,分别有5个目标。 这一分析包括与已执行的SkillOpt基线进行比较,不包括5个百分点以下的验证收益,不包括Live Mathematics Bench,其验证小组有18个项目。 我们把这六个比较作为描述性子集,而不是对整个任务模式矩阵的估计。

blocks.en: Each gain is measured relative to that run’s recorded initial skill score. Initial evaluation scores can differ between methods, so the ratios do not normalize away all differences in initialization, evaluation draws, or search budget. A ratio above 100% means the recorded test gain exceeds the recorded validation gain; it does not mean that accuracy exceeds 100%. The ratio can also be large because its denominator is small. We therefore report both absolute gains beside each ratio and keep final test accuracy as the primary result.
blocks.zh: 每个收益是相对于该跑步记录的初始技能分数来衡量的. 初步评价得分可能因方法不同而有差异,因此,这些比率并没有使初始化、评价抽取或搜索预算方面的所有差异都正常化。 百分率以上,是指所记录的测试增益超过所记录的验证增益;并不意味着精度超过100%. 其分母很小,因此比例也可能很大. 因此,我们报告除每个比率外的绝对收益,并将最后测试准确性作为主要结果。

blocks.en: The reported median ratios are 123.96% for AtomSearch and 82.09% for SkillOpt before rounding. These values describe the recorded point estimates. Repeated evaluation of fixed checkpoints would be needed to quantify their uncertainty and separate selection effects from differences in the learned skills.
blocks.zh: 报告的中位数比率为:原子搜索器为123.96%,技能为82.09%。 复出前取出. 这些数值描述了所记录的点估计. 需要对固定检查站进行反复评估,以量化其不确定性并区分选择效果和学习技能的差异。
